text:
daria: FYI found plaintext AWS keys in a staging ConfigMap during a churned deploy. Not in prod, but still bad. 

daria: snippet: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: staging-app-config
  namespace: staging
data:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: AKIAEXAMPLEX
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: verylongplaintextsecret
```

daria: discovered via `kubectl get configmap staging-app-config -n staging -o yaml` while debugging a failing deploy test.

chris: how did it get there? CI inject? image build?

daria: looks like an old helm values override from 2022 that someone pasted. Not from CI; it's in Git history of the chart (values-staging.yaml).

maya: ok — immediate plan: 1) Revoke the exposed AWS key 2) Create new key pair 3) Put creds into Vault (AWS secrets engine or kv with KMS wrap) 4) Patch k8s to reference Vault/secret and remove plaintext ConfigMap 5) Audit/log + ticket.

alex: I can run the revoke/create now if you want. Need the key id and affected IAM user.

daria: key id is AKIAEXAMPLEX, IAM user staging-app-runner. I'll open a quick IAM revoke.

oncall-sre: before revoking, confirm there are no live tasks using that key — otherwise we'll fail staging jobs. How many pods reference it?

daria: grep across manifests: 3 deployments in staging reference configmap/staging-app-config (staging-api, staging-worker, staging-metrics). Pods are restarted automatically and should pick up new creds within a minute after update.

alex: revoking now. running: `aws iam update-access-key --user-name staging-app-runner --access-key-id AKIAEXAMPLEX --status Inactive`

alex: creating replacement key pair via IAM and storing into Vault. Using Vault AWS secrets engine for rotating long-term access: `vault write aws/roles/staging-role credential_type=iam_user` then `vault read aws/creds/staging-role` to generate ephemeral creds for apps we can use.

vault-bot: New audit entries created: https://vault.internal.company/logs/streams/abcd1234 (audit enabled).

maya: prefer using Vault AWS dynamic creds (ephemeral) where possible. For things that need long-lived keys (legacy), store them in kv with KMS-wrapped values and short TTLs. Also add `secrets:disallow-configmaps-with-secret-like-keys` policy on the admission controller.

chris: can we do a targeted sweep to find other configmaps/secrets with SECRET, KEY, PASS, TOKEN in staging and prod?

maya: yes — run `kubectl get configmaps --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.data != null) | {ns:.metadata.namespace, name:.metadata.name, keys:(.data|keys)}'` then filter keys matching regex. I ran a quick scan: only this chart in staging and one legacy k8s job in dev. Prod scan returned nothing.

oncall-sre: after alex updates k8s to use Vault, what's the rollout strategy? canary update? rollback plan?

daria: plan: patch one deployment (staging-api) to mount init container that fetches creds from Vault. Verify pods become Ready and tests pass (5m). If ok, patch worker and metrics rolling update (maxUnavailable 1). Rollback: re-enable old key and re-apply original configmap if something fails.

alex: applying patch to staging-api to use Vault sidecar/configmap templating now: `kubectl -n staging set env deploy/staging-api --from=secret/vault-staging-aws --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -` (will validate).

maya: I've filed SEC-9876 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9876) with scope, blast radius, and next steps. Assigning to eng-sre for rollout and eng-security for audit.

vault-bot: Vault write successful: `kv/data/staging/aws` (version: 3) — stored with KMS envelope encryption.

alex: patched staging-api, pods are coming up. healthchecks passing. running integration tests.

daria: integration tests green for api. canary looks good. proceeding with worker patch now.

chris: reminder: update chart repo to remove plaintext override and add notes to changelog. Also add chart linter rule to fail on secret-like keys in configmap.

maya: after rollout, we'll: 1) mark old key for deletion in 7 days 2) rotate any related tokens 3) add audit log entries + evidence to ticket 4) schedule a retro + preventive policy.

oncall-sre: monitoring alert created to catch failed auths to AWS for staging: staging-aws-auth-failures.keeping an eye.

alex: worker and metrics patched, all pods ready. removing the plaintext ConfigMap: `kubectl -n staging delete configmap staging-app-config`

vault-bot: Audit stream: 12 entries for `kv/data/staging/aws` and policy changes: https://vault.internal.company/audit/streams/abcd1234

maya: good — once SEC-9876 has the evidence and logs, I'll close the ticket. Also adding follow-ups: admission controller rule, chart linter, team comms.

daria: thanks all. I'll confirm closure after the 7-day key deletion window passes. :thumbsup:
